article.headline: Noah Shelby, Tycen McDaniels lead UT Arlington over Bethesda 116-65 at Rainbow Classic
article.description: — Noah Shelby scored 22 points and Tycen McDaniels added a double-double as UT Arlington beat Bethesda (CA) 116-65 on Monday night in the third-place game of the Rainbow Classic.
article.linkText: Noah Shelby, Tycen McDaniels lead UT Arlington over Bethesda 116-65 at Rainbow Classic
article.story: HONOLULU -- — Noah Shelby scored 22 points and Tycen McDaniels added a double-double as UT Arlington beat Bethesda (CA) 116-65 on Monday night in the third-place game of the Rainbow Classic. Shelby shot 7 for 14 (4 for 10 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Mavericks (3-1). Tycen McDaniels totaled 16 points and 12 rebounds. Miles Goodman shot 5 of 7 from the field and 4 of 7 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points, while adding 13 rebounds. Kenji Cooper had 31 points to lead the Flames, an NCCAA Division I school. Isaiah Hawk added nine points and six rebounds, while Jaden Peters pitched in with eight points, five assists and four steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
